description: Search accumulated GAO bid-protest decisions by protester (company) name, e.g. "has <company> been cited in a bid protest" or "which GAO protests did Boeing file". Case-insensitive partial match. Only searches decisions already in this pack's rolling accumulation (see gao_protests_coverage) — not a full-text search of GAO's archive, which is not reachable from here.

protester.description: Protester/company name or partial name, e.g. "Guernsey" or "FCN".

name: gao_protests_search
